data.name: Venipuncture / Blood Draw

code.decode: Collection of venous blood by venipuncture

data.label: Blood Draw
data.description: Collection of venous blood samples for laboratory analysis including hematology, clinical chemistry, coagulation, lipids, serology, PK, PD, biomarkers, and immunogenicity assessments

data.name: Hematology Laboratory Testing

code.decode: Blood count; complete (CBC), automated (Hgb, Hct, RBC, WBC and platelet count) and automated differential WBC count

data.label: Hematology
data.description: Complete blood count and differential performed at multiple study visits for safety monitoring

data.name: Clinical Chemistry Laboratory Testing

code.decode: Comprehensive metabolic panel

data.label: Clinical Chemistry
data.description: Serum chemistry panel performed at multiple study visits for safety monitoring

data.name: Coagulation Testing

code.decode: Prothrombin time

data.label: Coagulation
data.description: Coagulation panel performed at screening

data.name: Fasting Lipid Panel

code.decode: Lipid panel

data.label: Lipids (Fasting)
data.description: Fasting lipid panel performed at baseline and Week 12 visits

data.name: Serum Pregnancy Test

code.decode: Gonadotropin, chorionic (hCG); quantitative

data.label: Serum Pregnancy Test
data.description: Serum beta-hCG pregnancy test performed at screening for individuals of childbearing potential

data.name: Urine Pregnancy Test

code.decode: Urine pregnancy test, by visual color comparison methods

data.label: Urine Pregnancy Test
data.description: Urine pregnancy test performed prior to dosing at multiple visits for individuals of childbearing potential; can be done on-site or at home in Study Period 2

data.name: Follicle-Stimulating Hormone (FSH) Testing

code.decode: Follicle stimulating hormone (FSH)

data.label: FSH Test
data.description: Serum FSH measurement to confirm postmenopausal status in individuals assigned female at birth

data.name: Parathyroid Hormone (PTH) Testing

code.decode: Parathormone (parathyroid hormone)

data.label: PTH Test
data.description: Serum parathyroid hormone measurement performed at baseline and end-of-study visits

data.name: Urinalysis

code.decode: Urinalysis, by dip stick or tablet reagent for bilirubin, glucose, hemoglobin, ketones, leukocytes, nitrite, pH, protein, specific gravity, and urobilinogen; automated, with microscopy

data.label: Urinalysis
data.description: Urine analysis performed at screening

data.name: HIV Testing

code.decode: Antibody; HIV-1 and HIV-2, single result

data.label: HIV Test
data.description: HIV screening test performed at screening

data.name: Hepatitis B Virus (HBV) Screening

code.decode: Infectious agent antigen detection by immunoassay technique, qualitative or semiquantitative; hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg)

data.label: HBV Screening
data.description: HBV screening including HBsAg and anti-HBc; if HBsAg negative and anti-HBc positive, further HBV DNA testing required

data.name: Hepatitis B Virus DNA Testing

code.decode: Infectious agent detection by nucleic acid (DNA or RNA); hepatitis B virus, quantitative

data.label: HBV DNA
data.description: HBV DNA quantitative testing for participants who are anti-HBc positive at screening, performed at multiple visits for monitoring

data.name: Hepatitis C Virus (HCV) Screening

code.decode: Hepatitis C antibody

data.label: HCV Screening
data.description: HCV antibody screening; if positive, HCV RNA test performed

data.name: Tuberculosis (TB) Testing

code.decode: Skin test; tuberculosis, intradermal

data.label: TB Test
data.description: Tuberculin skin test (TST/PPD) or equivalent TB test performed at screening; TST results read 48-72 hours after placement by trained medical professional

data.name: 12-Lead Electrocardiogram (ECG)

code.decode: Electrocardiogram, routine ECG with at least 12 leads; with interpretation and report

data.label: ECG, 12-Lead
data.description: Single local 12-lead ECG performed at screening, Week 2, and Week 12 of Study Period 1, and at early discontinuation if prior to Week 12

data.name: Chest X-Ray

code.decode: Radiologic examination, chest; 2 views

data.label: X-Ray of Chest
data.description: Chest radiograph performed locally in posterior-anterior view and lateral view if needed; interpreted by radiologist or pulmonologist; used for TB evaluation; chest CT scan may be used as alternative

data.name: Chest CT Scan

code.decode: Computed tomography, thorax; without contrast material(s)

data.label: Chest CT
data.description: Computed tomography of the chest used as an alternative to chest X-ray for TB evaluation within the same time window

data.name: Dual-Energy X-Ray Absorptiometry (DXA) Scan

code.decode: Dual-energy X-ray absorptiometry (DXA), bone density study, 1 or more sites; axial skeleton (eg, hips, pelvis, spine)

data.label: DXA Scan
data.description: DXA scan performed for bone density assessment; radiation exposure approximately 5 μSv or 0.005 mSv; performed at specified visits and at early discontinuation if during Study Period 1

data.name: Endoscopy with Biopsy

code.decode: Colonoscopy through stoma; with biopsy, single or multiple

data.label: Endoscopy with Biopsy
data.description: Endoscopy performed during screening (within 21 days before randomization) and at Week 12 of Study Period 1; biopsy obtained for histological scoring and exploratory biomarker analysis; second endoscopy allowed if inadequate preparation or equipment issues

data.name: Complete Physical Examination

code.decode: Office or other outpatient visit for the evaluation and management of an established patient

data.label: Complete Physical Exam
data.description: Complete physical examination performed at screening; excludes pelvic, rectal, and breast examinations unless clinically indicated; includes assessment of peripheral lymph nodes and TB risk factors

data.name: Symptom-Directed Physical Assessment

code.decode: Office or other outpatient visit, established patient, problem focused

data.label: Symptom-Directed Physical Assessment
data.description: Focused physical assessment performed at multiple visits; includes examination of eyes, throat, heart, lungs, abdomen, and visual examination of the skin; includes assessment of peripheral lymph nodes and TB risk factors

data.name: Vital Signs Measurement

code.decode: Office or other outpatient visit for the evaluation and management of an established patient, minimal

data.label: Vital Signs
data.description: Measurement of pulse rate, blood pressure, respiratory rate, and body temperature performed at all study visits

data.name: Height Measurement

code.decode: Body mass index (BMI), documented

data.label: Height
data.description: Height measurement performed at screening

data.name: Weight Measurement

code.decode: Body mass index (BMI), documented

data.label: Weight
data.description: Body weight measurement performed at multiple study visits

data.name: Fistula Evaluation

code.decode: Anoscopy; diagnostic, including collection of specimen(s) by brushing or washing, when performed

data.label: Fistula Evaluation
data.description: Evaluation for existing perianal fistulas (if present at baseline) and any newly developed fistulas; performed at baseline and multiple visits in Study Period 1

data.name: Crohn's Disease Activity Index (CDAI) Assessment

code.decode: Prolonged evaluation and management service

data.label: CDAI Assessment
data.description: Patient-reported items recorded daily via eDiary; clinician-reported items recorded at specified site visits; includes stool frequency, abdominal pain, general well-being, and bowel movement count

data.name: C-Reactive Protein High Sensitivity (hsCRP) Testing

code.decode: C-reactive protein; high sensitivity (hsCRP)

data.label: hsCRP
data.description: High-sensitivity C-reactive protein measurement performed at multiple visits in Study Period 2

data.name: Serum 25-Hydroxy Vitamin D Testing

code.decode: Vitamin D; 25 hydroxy, includes fraction(s), if performed

data.label: Serum 25-OH Vitamin D
data.description: Serum 25-hydroxy vitamin D measurement performed at end-of-study visit

data.name: Procollagen Type I N-Propeptide (P1NP) Testing

code.decode: Unlisted immunology procedure

data.label: P1NP
data.description: Serum P1NP bone formation marker measurement performed at end-of-study visit

data.name: C-Terminal Telopeptide (CTX-1) Testing

code.decode: Collagen cross links, any method

data.label: CTX-1
data.description: Serum CTX-1 bone resorption marker measurement performed at end-of-study visit

data.name: Bone-Specific Alkaline Phosphatase (ALP) Testing

code.decode: Immunoassay for analyte other than antibody or infectious agent antigen, quantitative; by radioimmunoassay

data.label: Bone-Specific ALP
data.description: Bone-specific alkaline phosphatase measurement performed at end-of-study visit

data.name: Fecal Calprotectin Testing

code.decode: Calprotectin, fecal

data.label: Fecal Calprotectin
data.description: Stool sample collection and fecal calprotectin measurement performed at multiple visits

data.name: Stool Culture

code.decode: Culture, bacterial; stool, aerobic, with isolation and presumptive identification of isolates

data.label: Stool Culture
data.description: Stool culture performed at Week 16 of Study Period 2; additional testing allowed at investigator's discretion

data.name: Clostridioides difficile (C. difficile) Testing

code.decode: Infectious agent detection by nucleic acid (DNA or RNA); Clostridium difficile, toxin gene(s), amplified probe technique

data.label: C. difficile Testing
data.description: Stool testing for C. difficile performed at Week 16 of Study Period 2; additional testing allowed at investigator's discretion

data.name: Exploratory Biomarker Blood Sample Collection

code.decode: Collection of venous blood by venipuncture

data.label: Exploratory Biomarker, Blood
data.description: Blood sample collection for exploratory biomarker analysis performed at multiple visits

data.name: Exploratory Biomarker Stool Supernatant Collection

code.decode: Sputum obtaining specimen, aerosol induced technique

data.label: Exploratory Biomarkers, Stool Supernatant
data.description: Stool supernatant collection for exploratory biomarker analysis; supernatant from same stool sample used for fecal calprotectin testing

data.name: Exploratory Biomarker Colonic Tissue Collection

code.decode: Colonoscopy through stoma; with biopsy, single or multiple

data.label: Exploratory Biomarkers, Colonic Tissue
data.description: Colonic tissue biopsy obtained during endoscopy for exploratory biomarker analysis at screening and Week 12

data.name: Genetics Sample Collection

code.decode: Collection of venous blood by venipuncture

data.label: Genetics Sample
data.description: Blood or other sample collected for genetic analysis at or after Visit 2 (baseline); subject to country regulations

data.name: Pharmacokinetic (PK) Sample Collection

code.decode: Collection of venous blood by venipuncture

data.label: PK Sample Collection
data.description: Blood sample collection for pharmacokinetic analysis of LY4395089 and mirikizumab

data.name: Immunogenicity Assessment

code.decode: Unlisted immunology procedure

data.label: Immunogenicity
data.description: Blood sample collection and analysis for anti-drug antibody assessment

data.name: Intravenous (IV) Infusion of Mirikizumab

code.decode: Chemotherapy administration, intravenous infusion technique; up to 1 hour, single or initial substance/drug

data.label: Mirikizumab IV Infusion
data.description: Intravenous infusion of mirikizumab administered on-site at Weeks 0, 4, and 8 of Study Period 1

data.name: Subcutaneous (SC) Injection of Mirikizumab

code.decode: Therapeutic, prophylactic, or diagnostic injection; subcutaneous or intramuscular

data.label: Mirikizumab SC Injection
data.description: Subcutaneous self-injection of mirikizumab using a prefilled syringe administered in Study Period 2; initial administration on-site under supervision; subsequent doses may be administered at home by participant or caregiver

data.name: Oral Administration of LY4395089

code.decode: Office or other outpatient visit, minimal

data.label: LY4395089 Oral Dosing
data.description: Oral administration of LY4395089 6 mg once daily at home; participants instructed to take at approximately the same time each day

data.name: Depression and Suicidal Ideation and Behavior Risk Monitoring

code.decode: Brief emotional/behavioral assessment

data.label: Depression/Suicidal Ideation Monitoring
data.description: Monitoring for depression and suicidal ideation and behavior using Columbia Suicide-Severity Rating Scale (C-SSRS) and Quick Inventory for Depressive Symptomatology - Self Report 16 items (QIDS-SR16)

data.name: Hepatic Safety Monitoring

code.decode: Hepatic function panel

data.label: Hepatic Safety Monitoring
data.description: Monitoring of liver function tests and evaluation for hepatic safety; criteria for study drug interruption or discontinuation applied

data.name: Injection/Infusion Site Reaction (ISR) Assessment

code.decode: Office or other outpatient visit for the evaluation and management of an established patient

data.label: ISR Assessment
data.description: Assessment and monitoring of injection and infusion site reactions

data.name: Hypersensitivity Reaction Assessment

code.decode: Office or other outpatient visit for the evaluation and management of an established patient

data.label: Hypersensitivity Reaction Assessment
data.description: Assessment and monitoring of hypersensitivity reactions; laboratory samples obtained at time of systemic hypersensitivity reaction

data.name: Urinary Albumin/Creatinine Ratio (UACR) Testing

code.decode: Albumin; urine, microalbumin, quantitative

data.label: UACR
data.description: Urine sample collection and analysis for urinary albumin/creatinine ratio

data.name: Simple Endoscopic Score for Crohn's Disease (SES-CD) Assessment

code.decode: Colonoscopy through stoma; diagnostic, including collection of specimen(s) by brushing or washing, when performed

data.label: SES-CD Assessment
data.description: Endoscopic scoring for Crohn's disease activity using the Simple Endoscopic Score for Crohn's Disease

data.name: Histological Scoring

code.decode: Level IV - Surgical pathology, gross and microscopic examination

data.label: Histological Assessment
data.description: Histological scoring of colonic biopsy tissue samples for disease activity assessment

data.name: Bowel Preparation

code.decode: Federally qualified health center (FQHC) visit, new patient

data.label: Bowel Preparation
data.description: Bowel preparation performed prior to endoscopy procedures

data.name: Electronic Daily Diary (eDiary) Completion

code.decode: Collection and interpretation of physiologic data digitally stored and/or transmitted by the patient

data.label: Daily eDiary
data.description: Daily electronic diary completed by participants for CDAI stool frequency, abdominal pain, general well-being, and bowel movement count assessments

data.name: Prefilled Syringe
data.label: PFS
data.description: Prefilled syringe used for subcutaneous self-administration of mirikizumab by participant or caregiver; initial administration on-site under supervision of study personnel

data.name: Electronic Diary (eDiary) Device
data.label: eDiary
data.description: Electronic diary device used by participants to record daily CDAI patient-reported outcomes including stool frequency, abdominal pain, general well-being, and bowel movement count

data.name: Interactive Web-Response System (IWRS)
data.label: IWRS
data.description: Interactive web-response system used for visit registration, randomization or assignment to ISA, and randomization to study intervention

data.name: 12-Lead ECG Device
data.label: ECG Machine
data.description: Local 12-lead electrocardiogram device used for single ECG recordings at screening, Week 2, and Week 12

data.name: Dual-Energy X-Ray Absorptiometry (DXA) Scanner
data.label: DXA Scanner
data.description: DXA imaging device used for bone density assessment; delivers approximately 5 μSv (0.005 mSv) effective radiation dose per scan

data.name: Stool Collection Kit
data.label: Stool Collection Kit
data.description: Kit dispensed to participants for collection of stool samples for fecal calprotectin testing, stool culture, C. difficile testing, and exploratory biomarker stool supernatant collection
